title: BearerAuth/BasicAuth auth_header: identical bodies across two impls
description: auth.rs lines 157-162 and 210-214: BearerAuth::auth_header and BasicAuth::auth_header have identical bodies — both return Some((AUTHORIZATION.as_str().to_string(), self.header_string.clone())). The shared structure is an AuthHeader struct or a free fn authorization_header(value: &str) -> (String, String) that both impls call. Rewrite: fn authorization_header(value: &str) -> (String, String) { (AUTHORIZATION.as_str().to_owned(), value.to_owned()) } and call it from both impls.
